type WidgetInfo struct {
	// the widget's display name

	CacheTTL *int         `js:"cacheTtl"`

func widgetInfoFromJS(v js.Value) (WidgetInfo, error) {
	var out WidgetInfo
	{
		out.Name = v.Get("widget_name").String()
	}
	{
		if s := v.Get("cacheTtl"); !s.IsUndefined() && !s.IsNull() {
			n := s.Int()
			out.CacheTTL = &n
		}
	}
	{
		out.Tags = make([]string, v.Get("tags").Length())
		for i := range out.Tags {
			out.Tags[i] = v.Get("tags").Index(i).String()
		}
	}
	{
		out.Status = WidgetStatus(v.Get("status").String())
	}
	{
		out.Secret = v.Get("secret")
	}
	return out, nil
}

func (o WidgetInfo) toJS() js.Value {
	obj := jsrt.NewObject()
	if o.Name != "" {
		obj.Set("widget_name", o.Name)
	}
	if o.CacheTTL != nil {
		obj.Set("cacheTtl", *o.CacheTTL)
	}
	if len(o.Tags) > 0 {
		arr := js.Global().Get("Array").New(len(o.Tags))
		for i, e := range o.Tags {
			arr.SetIndex(i, e)
		}
		obj.Set("tags", arr)
	}
	if o.Status != "" {
		obj.Set("status", string(o.Status))
	}
	if !jsrt.IsNil(o.Secret) {
		obj.Set("secret", o.Secret)
	}
	return obj
}
